## Phase 3: [US1] Website Content Extraction

**User Story**: As an AI engineer building the data ingestion layer for a RAG chatbot, I need to extract and clean content from the Docusaurus-based book website (https://ai-humanoid-robotics-course-book.vercel.app/) so that I can create a high-quality knowledge base for the chatbot.

**Goal**: Extract and clean content from all pages while filtering out navigation elements, headers, and other non-content elements

- [X] T012 [P] [US1] Implement get_sitemap_urls() function to parse sitemap.xml
- [X] T013 [P] [US1] Add sitemap namespace handling for Docusaurus structure
- [X] T014 [P] [US1] Implement URL filtering to include only target site content
- [X] T015 [P] [US1] Implement extract_text_from_url() function with Docusaurus selectors
- [X] T016 [P] [US1] Add content extraction for main educational content areas
- [X] T017 [P] [US1] Implement removal of navigation, headers, footers, and sidebars
- [X] T018 [P] [US1] Add error handling for failed URL requests
- [X] T019 [P] [US1] Implement metadata extraction (title, module, section)
- [X] T020 [P] [US1] Add text cleaning and whitespace normalization
- [X] T021 [P] [US1] Implement module/section hierarchy extraction from URL structure
- [X] T022 [P] [US1] Add rate limiting with 1-2 second delays between requests
- [X] T023 [US1] Test content extraction with sample URLs from target site

**Independent Test Criteria**: The extraction process successfully accesses all pages and extracts clean textual content from each page without including navigation elements, headers, or other non-content elements.

## Phase 4: [US2] Content Vectorization and Embedding Generation

**User Story**: As an AI engineer, I need the system to generate high-quality embeddings using Cohere models from the extracted content so that the RAG chatbot can perform accurate semantic searches against the knowledge base.

**Goal**: Generate vector representations that capture semantic meaning with high accuracy using Cohere embed-english-v3.0 model

- [X] T024 [P] [US2] Implement chunk_text() function with semantic chunking logic
- [X] T025 [P] [US2] Add configurable chunk size (1000 chars) and overlap (100 chars)
- [X] T026 [P] [US2] Implement chunking by document structure (headings, sections)
- [X] T027 [P] [US2] Preserve module/section hierarchy in chunk metadata
- [X] T028 [P] [US2] Implement embed_chunks() function using Cohere API
- [X] T029 [P] [US2] Add proper input_type specification for search_document
- [X] T030 [P] [US2] Implement embedding error handling and retry logic
- [X] T031 [P] [US2] Validate embedding dimensions (1024) for embed-english-v3.0
- [X] T032 [P] [US2] Add embedding metadata preservation (module, section, etc.)
- [X] T033 [US2] Test embedding quality with sample content chunks
- [X] T034 [US2] Verify semantic similarity with related content examples

**Independent Test Criteria**: Generating embeddings for known content and verifying that similar concepts have close vector representations, and that retrieval returns semantically relevant results.

**Goal**: Store embeddings with complete metadata in Qdrant database with proper indexing for efficient retrieval

- [X] T035 [P] [US3] Implement create_collection() function with proper configuration
- [X] T036 [P] [US3] Set up Qdrant collection with 1024-dimensional vectors and cosine distance
- [X] T037 [P] [US3] Configure HNSW indexing parameters for efficient search
- [X] T038 [P] [US3] Create payload indexes for metadata fields (url, module, section)
- [X] T039 [P] [US3] Implement save_chunks_to_qdrant() function with batch processing
- [X] T040 [P] [US3] Add proper payload structure with ContentChunk fields from data-model.md
- [X] T041 [P] [US3] Implement batch upload with 100-item chunks for efficiency
- [X] T042 [P] [US3] Add error handling and retry logic for Qdrant operations
- [X] T043 [P] [US3] Implement search_test() function for verification
- [X] T044 [P] [US3] Add proper metadata storage for ContentChunk, SourceMetadata, and EmbeddingVector entities
- [X] T045 [US3] Test storage and retrieval with sample queries like "sensorimotor intelligence"

**Independent Test Criteria**: Storing embeddings and verifying that they can be retrieved with appropriate similarity matching and that metadata is preserved correctly.

## Dependencies

- **User Story 2** depends on **User Story 1** (content extraction must work before embedding)
- **User Story 3** depends on **User Story 2** (embeddings must be generated before storage)
- **User Story 4** depends on **User Story 3** (complete pipeline requires working storage)

## Parallel Execution Examples

**User Story 1**: Tasks T012-T014 can be developed in parallel with T015-T017 as they address different aspects (URL discovery vs content extraction)

**User Story 2**: Tasks T024-T026 (chunking) can be developed in parallel with T028-T030 (embedding) as they are independent components

**User Story 3**: Tasks T035-T038 (collection setup) can be developed in parallel with T039-T042 (storage logic)

## Implementation Strategy

**MVP Scope**: Focus on User Story 1 (content extraction) as the foundational capability. This includes sitemap parsing, content extraction, and basic storage to validate the core approach.

**Incremental Delivery**:
1. Complete Phase 1 (Setup) and Phase 2 (Foundational) to establish base infrastructure
2. Deliver User Story 1 (Content Extraction) as MVP
3. Add User Story 2 (Embedding Generation) to enable semantic search
4. Complete User Story 3 (Storage) for full RAG capability
5. Add User Story 4 (Management) and polish features

This phased approach allows for early validation of the core extraction capability while building toward the complete RAG system.
